description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and extension methods for configuring memory streams within the Orleans framework, including silo-specific and client-specific configurators, with support for dependency injection and stream partitioning.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStreamConfigurator`1
classes.description: A generic class for configuring silo memory streams with a specific serializer type, supporting dependency injection and logging configuration.

classes.name: ClusterClientMemoryStreamConfigurator`1
classes.description: A generic class for configuring cluster client memory streams with a specific serializer type.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Extension method to configure the number of queues for memory streams using HashRingStreamQueueMapperOptions.

methods.name: SiloMemoryStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the silo memory stream configurator with a name and service configuration delegate.

methods.name: ClusterClientMemoryStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cluster client memory stream configurator with a name and builder.
